description: Wifi Hotspots is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Umeå kommun. Free surf spots within Umeå municipality with popular names on the site and geographical position. Coverage: Umeå kommun. The publisher named on the listing is Umeå kommun. Its keywords include Nätverk, Trådlöst, Wifi, Internet, Umeå kommun, Hotspots. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, GPX+XML, RDF_XML, CSV. The listing shows 2024-10-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.sv). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
